fr_html: Messieurs, les jurisconsultes qui sont assemblés à La Haye me pardonneront d'avoir semblé devancer les avis que nous sollicitons de leur science et de leur expérience.
en_html: Gentlemen, the jurists who are assembled at The Hague will pardon me for having appeared to forestall the advice which we solicit from their knowledge and their experience.
